title: The inseparability application repeats the output-one set on both sides.
details: Marks, dated 2024-02-25, Lemma 14.6 proof, printed p. 61 (PDF61), final sentence. Visually checked: both named setsA andB use phi_n(n)=1, although the preceding argument shows inclusion of the output-zero set and exclusion of the output-one set. Replace A by{n:phi_n(n) converges to0}, leaving B as the output-one set. The preceding reasoning then invokes exactly Theorem 4.14. This adjacent model-theory application is not used by the new entries or by the pending standalone inseparability entry.
